claims.claim: computer vision tracks all 22 players from one broadcast camera
facts: players in view per tracked wide frame: about 11-16 on average in the featured passages (e.g. 15.6 in Liverpool 802600, 10.7 in Amad's 869000); 18 or more of 22 on about 11% of all tracked frames (v7 coverage report)
detector: RF-DETR Medium 1.11.2, COCO-pretrained (Apache-2.0), not trained by us; person recall 0.9927 on 200 hand-labelled frames (T-105, packages/evals/pitchwatch/recall.py)
tracker: ByteTrack (trackers 2.6.1); teams by kit colour; our camera calibration puts feet on the pitch in metres (check points mean 0.32 m, max 2.21 m against a 1.5 m gate, T-104 still open)
ball: the same detector on 640 px tiles; 32 of 32 sampled detections were the ball
claims.use: Computer vision tracks every player in view from one broadcast camera
claims.verdict: not exact: the camera shows part of the pitch

facts: pass model (the one trained model behind the on-screen numbers): LightGBM, 2,146,079 training passes from 1,600 matches simulated by our Kickoff engine (val 200, test 200); test AUC 0.823, calibration error 0.0044
other heads trained on the same 2,000 simulated matches (xG, goal in 8 s, chaos, win probability) are not used for v5-v8 on-screen numbers: shot xG is the published reference model
MomentEncoder: trained on MPS on 360 simulated matches (486,000 states) in 3.8 min, test purity 0.7153 (gate 0.6); not behind any v5-v8 number

decision policy (set transformer, about 4.7M parameters): trained on MPS on 1,600 simulated matches plus 120 GRF games (Radke & Tilbury, licence unconfirmed); it failed its gate (top3_kind_target_accuracy 0.5050 misses >= 0.8), so the engine stayed scripted_v1; no v6-v8 number uses a rollout (v5's cut ghost-future figure used 2,000 scripted_v1 rollouts)
claims.use: A pass model we trained on 2.1 million passes from 1,600 simulated matches
claims.verdict: true only if it names what was trained and that the training data is simulated

claims.claim: an xG model fitted on 8,451 Premier League shots
facts: evals.pitchwatch.shotxg.reference_xg uses Soccermatics' published logistic coefficients (distance, angle and their interactions); we did not fit it
sanity bands pass: six-yard central 0.30-0.50, edge of box 0.06-0.12, 30 m 0.02-0.04; penalty 0.76 is Wyscout's fixed value (evals.pitchwatch.v5 gate)
claims.use: A published xG model (Soccermatics), fitted on 8,451 Premier League shots from 2017/18 (Wyscout data)
claims.verdict: true for the model, but it is published, not ours
